2.200.17
RadialPointer.PointerCap
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialPointer.PointerCap element specifies style properties for the pointer cap of a
RadialPointer. This element is optional. This element is of type PointerCap.
The following is the parent element of the RadialPointer.PointerCap element.
Parent elements
RadialPointer
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialPointer.PointerCap element.
 <xsd:element name="PointerCap" type="PointerCapType" minOccurs="0">
